glosses: To shout out in order to summon (a person).

examples.text: I leant out of the back door and called for Lucy.

glosses: To ask for in a loud voice.

examples.text: We finished the main course in short order and called for more wine.

glosses: To request, demand.

examples.text: The government has called for an end to hostilities in the region.
In Juazeiro do Norte, demonstrators cornered the mayor inside a bank for hours and called for his impeachment, while thousands of others protested teachers’ salaries.
In fact, he had called for the execution of Yun Chich'ung and Kwon Sangyon in 1791.

glosses: To necessitate, demand, exact; to make appropriate

examples.text: This situation calls for a high degree of courage.
This called for an immediate response. A factory-wide meeting was called, and the head of the Workers' Rebellion Organization announced that a "counter-revolutionary clique" was on the loose.

glosses: To stop at a place and ask for (someone).

examples.text: I'll call for you just after midday.

glosses: To anticipate, predict.

examples.text: The forecast calls for rain.
